selection: Smallest calibrated EB absolute benchmark error among retained targets where calibrated EB is closest, its 95% interval contains the benchmark, and observational and illusion intervals exclude it. Selected after inspecting the saved estimates for illustration; the benchmark is noisy.
interpretation: Points and horizontal 95% intervals. Gaussian posterior intervals condition on fitted prior parameters. The red line marks the held-out experimental benchmark; its normal 95% confidence interval appears in the top row. The gray observational interval is a normal confidence interval for the contacted-minus-uncontacted contrast and includes sampling uncertainty only.
